additional_concerns: All 12 required pairs are retained. NOT_APPLICABLE concerns only the exact gift questions; it does not authorize pruning advertising duties or establish overall candidate correctness.
The source packet supplies the service context, paragraphs 9–10 and footnote 4. Claims that these passages are missing are stale. The external instruments referenced in them remain unavailable.
Footnote 4 includes supplementary FAQs and SFC guidance in the advertising standard. The Guidelines-only reading is incomplete; the supported claim must retain those supplements.

Code of Conduct paragraphs 3.11 and 2.3 and the answer to question 1 of the 30 September 2010 Code FAQ are not supplied as external dependencies. Their texts are needed for further interpretation of those standards, although the circular supports its express statements. No dependency IDs are supplied.

Scope placement changes executable answers. node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e places offer occurrence in Scope; node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f, node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5 and both offer-level candidates place promotional linkage there. Absent linkage or occurrence therefore returns OUT_OF_SCOPE instead of a negative prohibition answer or positive selected-control compliance answer. Retain the alternatives of an intentionally restricted question domain and a substantive condition misplaced in Scope; unknown scope also prevents otherwise decisive result facts from determining the answer.

Both offer-level candidates combine offer-wide promotional linkage with an existential gift classification. The same offered gift component must have the required promotional connection; otherwise an unrelated gift could be caught because another component promotes a product.

The aggregate fact in node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 does not expressly require complete component enumeration or preserve unresolved component classifications. Shared UNKNOWN semantics cannot establish that upstream aggregation is sound.

The circular defines distributors in the context of SFC-authorised funds but quotes a restriction referring to investment products generally. Preserve the distinction between implementing this circular's selected scope and implementing the broader Code provision; the latter requires the external text and an explicit scope decision.

Gift and discount classifications remain supplied judgments. Additional returns or incentives are not automatically gifts, and failure to constitute a structured product is not an exemption from the gift restriction. A separate discount does not exempt another gift component.

node.142f34016b300f5c110eb249 should bind 'provider' to the actor offering the component. Funding or fulfilment alone does not establish offer attribution. Conversely, the source does not make payment, acceptance or actual receipt prerequisites to an offer.
FALSE, OUT_OF_SCOPE and selected-gift-control compliance do not establish general legal permission. Advertising and other applicable duties remain separate.
The supplied source does not establish a concrete effective-date interval or the applicable versions of external authorities. Current or historical applicability remains unresolved.
